members.name: acceptedFileTypes
members.doc: The MIME types or extensions the picker offers. It sets the native accept attribute and narrows the picker without validating the choice.

members.name: allowsMultiple
members.doc: Lets the picker select more than one file.

members.name: acceptDirectory
members.doc: Lets the picker select a directory instead of files, through the native webkitdirectory attribute.

members.name: defaultCamera
members.doc: Picks the camera a capture uses, the front one for user or the rear one for environment, through the native capture attribute.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the trigger: the picker does not open, and onSelect is not called.

members.name: onSelect
members.doc: Reports the chosen files as an array of File objects.
